R-06: Play the latest video from Hoops TV.
Goal: Play the latest video from Hoops TV.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/r-06/
STEP 2: Click "Accept all"
STEP 3: Hover over "Watch"
STEP 4: Click "Hoops TV"
STEP 5: Select "Newest" in "Sort by"
STEP 6: Click "Watch video" under "Courtside Live: Season Opener Preview"
STEP 7: Click "Play"
STEP 8: Verify "Playing: Courtside Live: Season Opener Preview (Hoops TV)" is visible
